question: Mahesh bought some sharpeners for ₹150 per dozen. He sold them for ₹21 each. His profit percentage is ________%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total CP for 1 dozen (12 items) = ₹150

Total SP for 1 dozen = 12 × ₹21 = ₹252

Ratio of CP : SP = 150 : 252 = 25 : 42

Profit ratio = 42 − 25 = 17 units

Profit % = (17 ÷ 25) × 100 = 68%

**∴ The correct answer is 68%.**
